body_text:
A subgroup $N\leq G$ is normal, written $N\trianglelefteq G$,
if $gN=Ng$ for every $g\in G$. Equivalently, $gNg^{-1}=N$ for
every $g\in G$. Normality is precisely the compatibility
condition needed for multiplication of cosets to be independent
of the chosen representatives.
